kicker: The 2018 draft STEM Tech Stack, redrawn
title: Mapping the tech stack per generation
subtitle: The three figures the 2018 chapter linked and the 2018 repository never rendered, drawn from the lists under them. What is struck through is struck through in the 2018 text.
alt: Three columns, Gen X, Gen Y and Gen Z. Gen X: brain, pen, paper, scientific calculator. Gen Y keeps the brain and pen and paper, strikes the scientific calculator, and adds spreadsheets, computer, mobile, internet, email and data center. Gen Z keeps brain and pen and paper, adds AI and ML and voice, and strikes the calculator, spreadsheets, computer and mobile, internet, email and data center.

items.label: Internet
items.detail: disappears since it becomes a commodity where everything is connected to it

legend: The 2018 text left most items as "...", to be written; the labels here are its words and nothing is added. Gen Z's 2018 list says "AI and LM" in its label and "ML" in its gloss; the label follows the gloss.
source_line: Source: v1/content/1.introduction/stem-tech-stack.md, the 2018 draft STEM Tech Stack (CC BY 4.0, decision 001). Figures STEM-tech-stack_001 to _003 were linked from puml-graphs/diagrams/stem/ and never generated.
